_comment: Zevara Sunderscale STAYS at the gate (zevara_intro's own framing untouched)
_kits_recompose: #620 — art-read FIX loop 1: sconce, note and crate moves
interior_flavor: Nothing there. Bare stone, and a rack of spare kit with every strap buckled the same way.
Nothing there. A shield knocks against its peg down the corridor, then goes quiet.

floor_layers._pick: #225 floor differentiation: the Watch barracks reads as institutional grey stone, not inn planks. Castle Environment stone-floor block ([4,11]/[5,11]/[6,11]/[4,12], flat warm-grey rgb~104,97,81) -- the pack the asset catalog casts for 'Watch barracks interior'; already manifest-wired (bundle:true) and in-use for pallass. Biome stays 'inn' so footsteps keep the wood family (a biome-key swap is out of this floor lane's scope; logged as follow-up).

entities.observe: A belt-slate at his hip, chalk stub worn to a nub, already a line into today's tally. Rust-brown scales, no plate for a desk posting — he'd rather be finishing the count than talking to you.
talk_pool: If you're here to report something, report it plain. You do the talking, the belt-slate writes it down.
Quiet shift. Kit's counted, slates are current, and the cell's empty. Write that down as a good day.
Barracks business, filed here. Yours is filed at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: Sergeant Ashgrave
dialogue.text: Barracks is Watch business only. State yours.

talk_pool_stages._comment: b7 #207 ack (lowest priority — any later stage outranks). delivered_* counters never reset; ack register must read fine forever.
lines: Gear crate came in. Counted. Correct. That's rarer than you'd think.

talk_pool_stages._comment: b7 #207 standing-run familiarity — the standing row re-banks every run, so this is a permanent register shift by design.
lines: Kit run's yours when the board posts it. Quartermaster stopped double-checking your counts. Take that as the compliment it is.

entities._comment: she stays at the gate (zevara_intro unchanged)
entities.observe: Tidier than her schedule allows. A stack of gate-shift reports pinned under a paperweight shaped vaguely like a threat. She is almost never behind it.
entities.toast: Watch Captain's desk. Empty, same as every other time you've walked past it.

entities.locked_toast: Barred, and empty behind the bars. You can tell by the quiet.
entities.observe: A single holding cell, iron-barred, straw swept into one corner. The bucket in the other corner is clean and dry.
A straw-packed target lashed to a post, set against the wall where a stray shot won't find a person. Scored through in a tight cluster at chest height, and the post rocks when you test it.
entities.item_hint_toast: Nothing to shoot with. A bow in hand would do it.
entities._comment_330: #330 R5: was an uncapped, undecayed ranged_hit spigot. One drill a waking now, and it pays a real shaft.
entities.once_per_waking_toast: Your arm is done for today. The shafts are out of the straw and back in the quiver.
entities.toast: The shaft goes into the straw and stands there. You walk down and pull it out for the next draw.

entities._comment: ORDER IS CONTRACT: field_whetstone stays FIRST -- barracks_walkthrough waits on its item_gained/toast pair before anything else. solid_oak_spear appended second (yard-turned practice spear, its own lore's home).
entities.observe: A second kit crate, shoved into the corner and never reshelved. The sergeant's own tally probably missed it.
A folded half-letter, tucked behind a loose board. The last line on it stops in the middle of a word.
A scrap of paper pinned low, tucked behind a loose board same as the letter across the room.

entities._comment: #453 P1 rest signposting: a Liscor-side bed, present once the Watch first sends the player below the city. Cell (1,1) is the empty north-west corner, off every canonical walked cell; (2,1) and (1,2) stay open, so no prior-version save is trapped. Mechanically identical to every other sleep prop.
